key.name: timeout
key.summary: Hide cursor timeout
key.description: Time in seconds after which the cursor is hidden when idle.

key.name: hide-on-typing
key.summary: Hide the cursor when typing
key.description: Hide as soon as there is input other than pointer motion or clicks, i.e. typing or scrolling with a resting pointer.

key.name: animate-app-hide
key.summary: Animate when an app hides its own cursor
key.description: Video players and fullscreen browsers hide the cursor by themselves.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Apps over which the cursor is never hidden
key.description: Desktop file IDs, such as org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop.

key.name: hide-style
key.summary: Animation when the cursor hides

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Hide animation duration in milliseconds

key.name: show-style
key.summary: Animation when the cursor shows again

key.name: show-duration
key.summary: Show animation duration in milliseconds

key.name: drop-count
key.summary: Number of drops

key.name: drop-size
key.summary: Drop size, relative to the default

key.name: drop-distance
key.summary: How far the drops travel, relative to the default

key.name: drop-gravity
key.summary: How much the drops fall, relative to the default

key.name: drop-shape
key.summary: Drop shape

key.name: custom-color-enabled
key.summary: Use a custom drop color instead of the cursor's

key.name: custom-color
key.summary: Custom drop color (#rrggbb)

key.name: hide-sound
key.summary: Sound played when the cursor hides

key.name: hide-sound-file
key.summary: Sound file played when the cursor hides, if hide-sound is 'file'

key.name: show-sound
key.summary: Sound played when the cursor shows again

key.name: show-sound-file
key.summary: Sound file played when the cursor shows, if show-sound is 'file'

key.name: debug
key.summary: Log hiding decisions to the journal
